(2) The quantity, verbatim (.quantity): "Q_JFWD = max(the head peak over the record, max over T in 0.2-0.5 ms of S(T) on the light window (record start before the light to 150 ms after the first crossing of 8 bar abs, from rest, held after it) and on each excursion window (50 ms before to 150 ms after an upward crossing of 45 bar abs later than the light window, from equilibrium at its start)); S(T) the undamped SDOF ESP of Z3 v2; sample step <= 0.05 ms in the windows, else Q_JFWD is a lower bound (the peak)"; level 60.0 bar abs, duration: none (one exceedance at any time in the run). (3) Envelope rules, verbatim (.rules[1], [2]): "an event that leaves the envelope is outside the structural basis: no margin claim, engine quarantined for inspection (v1, kept)"; "one Z3 event per J-FWD assembly: the line-231 basis is a one-off abnormal event; a second Z3 excursion before the replacement is outside the envelope (stated in v2; OPEN for the lead where it bears on the flight relight)".
